content: Vitamin D deficiency is also referred to as hypovitaminosis D or low vitamin D. The definition and diagnostic criteria for vitamin D deficiency are highly complex and challenging to establish. According to a narrative review, more than 60 Mendelian randomization studies have been conducted to assess the effects of lifelong genetically reduced serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D (25OHD) concentrations on various health outcomes. These studies are specifically designed to minimize bias caused by confounding factors. However, the majority of these studies have reported no significant effects of genetically low serum 25OHD levels on the outcomes evaluated.
